correctness.rationale: IRV was independently implemented under the stated unique-elimination/unique-final convention. Exact enumeration gives no reinforcement pair for totals 2 through 12 and exactly 288 unordered pairs at total 13, all split 5+8. Independent symmetry counting gives 48 pair orbits of size 6; the 288 pairs produce 126 unions in 21 orbits, with partition multiplicity histogram 1:36, 2:36, 3:36, 4:18. These numbers satisfy the required weighted total 288 and reproduce the displayed witness.

originality.rationale: Prior work establishes reinforcement failure for Hare/IRV, the 13-voter minimum, and—more recently—necessary and sufficient conditions for whether a fixed three-candidate union admits some paradox-producing partition. The audited theorem resolves a different finite boundary object: every unordered minimal pair, its candidate orbit, all 126 union profiles, and the exact 1/2/3/4 partition-multiplicity distribution. No checked source supplied that pair-and-partition census.
